name: MainchainGatewayV3 cached operator weight left at zero collapses the withdrawal quorum
summary: MainchainGatewayV3's new implementation reads a cached total operator weight that only initializeV3 sets, but the upgrade ran initializeV4, skipping it for good. The cached weight stayed zero, so minimumVoteWeight returned 0 and any signature passed withdrawal verification. MEV bots submitted withdrawal receipts naming themselves as recipients and drained the gateway.
notes: The anchor is the first of the twelve Withdrew events between the upgrade and the pause, one block after the upgrade, not the widely reported 3,996 ETH leg. Replayed against the pre-upgrade state, every one of the twelve reverts on signature checks, so none was a genuine user withdrawal.
The searchers returned the funds for a bounty weeks later; per rule 5 a return after a bounty offer does not make the takes a rescue, and recoveries are not subtracted.
MainchainBridgeManager relayed the upgrade proposal but carries no defect; the omission was the skipped initializer, so the upgrade sets a 12-second age.
